why: CRT memcpy (sub_00188F80): trail-byte arm 0 of the table at 0x001890CC (copy nothing, return dst). The unaligned short-copy path at 0x00188FD4 reaches it through jmp [ecx*4+0x001890DC] with ecx in -4..-1, an indirect jump the recompiler cannot follow into the function's own labels.

CRT memcpy: trail-byte arm 1 (copy one byte, return dst), reached the same way. Unresolved, every copy of one byte to an unaligned destination copied nothing: [ICALL] Failed to resolve VA 0x001890E4, 155 times in a Windows run that later crashed.

CRT memcpy (sub_00188F80): last arm of its trail-byte table at 0x001890CC (copy 3 bytes, leave, ret). The disassembler split the table's arms off the function and found this one nowhere, so every copy ending in three odd bytes was an unresolvable dispatch that copied nothing.
CRT x87 math special-case table (0x0040E6EE): 'ret'. Reached by jmp [ebx] from sub_0018C0xx.
CRT x87 math special-case table (0x0040ADF0): fstp st0, then falls into 0x0018C0EE (fstp st0; fldz; ret). Unresolved at run time in game: [ICALL] Failed to resolve VA 0x0018C0EC.
CRT x87 math special-case table (0x0040B3E2 and others): store/reload, set a status byte, ret.

CRT x87 math special-case table (0x0040B1E4 and on): fstp st0 twice, fld the constant at 0x0040B280, set a status byte unless already set, ret. Unresolved at run time with two of the 2002 preview's levels as Showdown stages (lvl_tng, lvl_flash): [ICALL] Failed to resolve VA 0x0018C18E, then a crash.
